slides.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Apera is a founder-led specialist staffing business recruiting for Aerospace, Defense, Space, Automotive, Clean Energy and AI & Robotics clients.
Founder and CEO Alex Woodhead spent six years as a Director at Cubiq Recruitment, then co-founded Strativ Group in 2019. He left Strativ in 2023 and launched Apera in January 2024.
Apera runs a full-service model across contract, permanent, executive search and embedded RPO, taking clients from transactional hiring to subscription RPO partnerships.
Alex has relocated to Los Angeles to lead the US build, where Apera's client base is concentrated.

slides.title: Business Model

stats.label: Of total comp on VP and C-suite search

bullets: Embedded RPOs billed as a monthly subscription, with the goal of owning 100% of a client's talent acquisition spend.
Sales motion: map the top 10 to 20 companies in a niche, then win them across RPO, permanent, contract and executive search.
Demand is not the constraint. The priority is operational rigor to deliver on the work already won, which is exactly what this hire owns.

slides.title: Why Apera?
items: A founder who has done it before: Director at Cubiq, co-founder of Strativ Group, now building Apera.
Fast growth: from 43 to 57 people during 2026, with 60 targeted by year end and 100 in two to three years.
A multi-service model anchored in subscription RPO revenue, not one-off fees.
Technical, venture-backed markets: aerospace, defense and space today, robotics and AI hardware next.
A seat at the top table with significant equity in a business built to scale.
A clear code: relationship led, do the right thing, best in the world.

slides.title: The Role
slides.intro: Apera is hiring a Chief Revenue Officer to run the revenue engine alongside Alex Woodhead.
items: C-suite or VP level. Titles in scope include CRO, CCO, or VP of Revenue Operations or Commercial; a VP hire is expected to grow into the C-suite.
Owns front-end operations across the recruitment and sales organisation, not back office.
Reports to Alex Woodhead. The Head of Talent and Head of Performance report in; sales MDs and leaders report to both.
Alex focuses on strategy, growth, hiring and sales. This hire runs the operation and the team.
Built to lead a sales organisation projected to reach 250 to 500 people in two to three years.
Open compensation for the right person: $300k+ base for an LA-based C-suite hire, bonus on company and personal performance, an extra layer if fee-earning, and significant equity.
